t: Magnusson 180 grit multi-material hand sanding sheets are designed for dry preparation and finishing. The fine abrasive papers feature durable brown corundum grain and a flexible C-weight backing to handle flat, contoured or irregular surfaces. Ideal for professional painters and plasterers preparing wood, paint, metal and plaster, providing efficient material removal with professional results. The strong paper construction reduces clogging and minimises heat buildup, ensuring smoother finishes and a longer product lifespan during demanding trade tasks.
